alvo.gramatica: on + dia festivo × at + período festivo

alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a preposição: On Christmas Eve, we build a snowman. At Christmas, we wear a warm scarf. On Christmas Day, we open presents.
falas: Mum, on Christmas Eve, we build a snowman.
Yes. At Christmas, we wear a warm scarf.
And on Christmas Day, we open presents.
